headline: Wipro: SEBI Takeover Regulation Disclosure by Ganesh Kumar Ramachandran
sum: Promoter/shareholder Ganesh Kumar Ramachandran files mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code with NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition threshold crossed or material holding change at Wipro Limited.
implication: Regulation 31(4) filings mark the formal gate for public disclosure of substantial acquisitions; the specific shareholding quantum and transaction structure must be verified in the full disclosure document to assess takeover code compliance, open offer obligations, and director appointment implications.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4) requires prompt disclosure to the exchange when a party acquires or crosses a threshold in shares/voting rights. Ganesh Kumar Ramachandran's disclosure to NSE indicates either a new material acquisition by him or a crossing of a regulatory threshold (commonly 5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, etc.). The filing must be accompanied by detailed disclosures on the nature of acquisition, consideration, timing, and intent—key inputs for Wipro's board and shareholders.
